ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Prospective shareholders, directors, legal representative, ultimate beneficial owner and all authorized signatories must be screened against PBOC real-name verification, the PRC market-entity blacklist, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions, OFAC SDN list including the 50% ownership rule, EU/UK sanctions if relevant, FATF public statements, and cross-strait restricted-party lists. Enhanced due diligence applies to any PEP, any cross-border remittance over USD 5,000, and every name-match hit. All screening results, adverse media, negative news, and decisions must be documented and refreshed at filing, quarterly, and upon UBO or director changes.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Enterprise Name Online Self-Service Declaration and Reservation System
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: For a PRC WFOE, the registered name must use simplified Chinese script and follow four tiers: administrative division tier + distinctive trade name tier + industry description tier + legal form tier (Limited Liability Company). The trade name cannot be identical or confusingly similar to existing names. A foreign-invested enterprise may also file a Latin-script company name, but it must be a transliteration or semantic equivalent of the Chinese trade name, approved by SAMR, and used consistently in foreign investment reporting. Pinyin-only names without Chinese characters are not accepted.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a name rejection, obtain the written refusal from SAMR, then within 15 working days file a written administrative reconsideration with the same registration authority showing that the rejected name has no bad-faith similarity to existing registered rights and that all prohibited tokens have been removed; include an amended name proposal and legal opinion. If reconsideration is denied, appeal to the next higher SAMR or the local people's government within 15 working days; if still denied, commence administrative litigation in the competent People's Court and simultaneously reserve a new name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Rejected for this industry. PRC tax registration, bank account opening, and Apple/Google/Stripe onboarding require a physical business address matching the lease and business license. A commercial mailbox or bare virtual office is not acceptable; a serviced office or co-working suite with an actual lease agreement, nameplate, staffed desks, and landlord consent for tax inspection may be accepted only if the landlord permits re-registration and unannounced physical inspections.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: (1) nameplate matches business license; (2) lease and property rights of use; (3) accounting staff and books; (4) computer/server infrastructure; (5) invoices or delivery records; (6) tax declaration trails. Quantified risk: municipal tax authorities conduct unannounced visits in 45-65% of newly registered WFOEs in digital services when first-year actual office expenses or payroll are low; SAMR random inspections are 10-25% annually; risk rises to approximately 70% if a compliance complaint or negative law-enforcement report is filed.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), together with the Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 10, 23, 24, 27, 31, 37, 38, 47, 55, 56, 57 and 68; Special Administrative Measures (Negative List) for Foreign Investment Access (2022 Edition); Regulations on the Administration of the Registration of Companies (2021), State Administration for Market Regulation.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the local Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) of the registered place; establishment registration is effected through the National Enterprise Registration Service Portal and the integrated multi-certificate one-stop platform.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Company Establishment Registration of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company, submitted together with the adopted Articles of Association, cross-strait notarised and verified shareholder qualification documents, the paid-in capital confirmation from the capital contribution supervision bank, and the registered address proof; the authority issues a business license bearing the Unified Social Credit Code.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None as a statutory minimum for this ordinary digital content WFOE under the Foreign Investment Negative List; the registered capital is freely fixed by the shareholders in the Articles of Association. Under the Company Law (2023 Revision), subscribed capital must be fully paid within five years from the date of establishment unless a shorter or longer period is lawfully specified. Cash contributions must be wired into a dedicated capital contribution account opened in the company's name at a bank authorized to receive foreign invested capital. This account is restricted in the sense that funds are held for paid-in capital verification and may not be disbursed for operating purposes until the business license is issued and the account is converted into a basic deposit account; no government-controlled escrow blocking mechanism applies beyond this standard capital verification arrangement. For the Taiwanese shareholder, remittance must also satisfy SAFE foreign exchange registration and cross-strait banking documentation requirements.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Memorandum and Articles of Association presented to this meeting are adopted; each page is initialled by the Executive Director and the Chairman is directed to execute the final Articles; the registered office of the Company is hereby adopted at [Legal Address], [District], [City], People's Republic of China; and the registration agent is authorized to file all necessary establishment documents with the local Administration for Market Regulation. RESOLVED, that the registered capital of the Company be fixed as set forth in the Articles of Association; the subscription of each founding shareholder is approved, and the Board acknowledges the statutory obligation to compel payment of all subscribed capital within five years from establishment in compliance with the revised Company Law; payments are to be made by lawful wire transfer into a dedicated capital contribution account at a bank authorized to accept foreign investment; no share certificate or capital confirmation shall be issued until the paid-in capital has been received and verified by the supervising bank. RESOLVED, that [Name] be and is hereby appointed Executive Director, [Name] be appointed Supervisor, [Name] be appointed General Manager and Legal Representative, and [Name] be appointed Chief Financial Officer, each to hold office until the next annual shareholders meeting and until successors are duly elected or appointed; the said officers are authorized severally, where lawful, to execute contracts, represent the Company before governmental authorities, and complete company registration, tax registration, foreign exchange registration, social insurance and statistical filings. RESOLVED, that the Company shall open one or more corporate deposit accounts with [Bank Name]; the General Manager and the Chief Financial Officer are designated as primary account signatories; the corporate seal governance policy requires that all contracts and payments above [Amount] bear the corporate seal and two original authorized signatures, one of which must be the General Manager unless an express two-signatory matrix is established; the officers are directed to submit certified copies of this resolution to the bank and to maintain an updated signatory register. RESOLVED, that all preparatory acts of the promoters and authorized representatives performed prior to this resolution are ratified; the officers are directed to cause the company seal to be engraved and registered at the public security authority, to convert the temporary capital account into a basic deposit account, to apply for invoice and social insurance registrations, and to execute all post-license steps contained in the formation SOP. RESOLVED, that this resolution is effective immediately and shall be recorded in the statutory books; the Company Secretary is directed to certify a copy under seal for delivery to the bank, the tax authority and the registration authority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Pre-registration and Foreign Investment Negative List Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) through the National Enterprise Registration Service Portal, with initial consultation to the local foreign investment promotion office for negative list compatibility.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application through the AMR online portal using the Taiwanese shareholder passport and power of attorney. Select a trade name that is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing enterprise in the same industry, and include the company type descriptor. Prepare a Chinese and English business scope corresponding to ISIC 5911, expressed in lawful operational wording such as production and global digital distribution of vertical micro-drama audiovisual content through a mobile streaming application, avoiding any wording that implies prohibited broadcasting or news editorial activities. The AMR will screen the name, structure and business scope against the Special Administrative Measures for Foreign Investment. The proposed wholly foreign-owned limited liability company is a permitted structure for this digital content activity because it does not require industrial licensing, does not involve physical manufacturing, and is not listed as prohibited; the result is a Name Pre-Approval Notice. If the name is rejected, revise and resubmit; if the negative-list check raises a restricted activity, the applicant must narrow the scope or restructure into a joint venture before proceeding.
required_dossiers: Cover letter signed by the proposed legal representative
Passport copy and power of attorney of the Taiwan shareholder
Proposed company names with Chinese and English identifiers
Project business scope description aligned with ISIC 5911 and NAICS 512110
Representative address proof and intended registered address lease
Foreign investment negative list compliance questionnaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is queried, respond through the portal within ten working days with a revised name or an explanation. If the application is suspended, obtain the written suspension reason and cure the identified defect, such as an inadequate business scope description or a shareholder documentation gap. If the AMR refuses the negative-list screening, request an administrative review or re-submit after removing restricted words from the business scope.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Cross-Strait Notarization and Authentication of Shareholder Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan notary public, Straits Exchange Foundation for certification, Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits verification channels, and the receiving local AMR window.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Taiwanese shareholder must execute the power of attorney, capital contribution declaration, consent to serve as director and supervisor, and articles of incorporation of the shareholder if the investing party is a corporate entity. Execute these documents before a notary public in Taiwan, and obtain notarial certification of the signatures and identity. The notarized document package must then be processed through the Straits Exchange Foundation for certification and transmitted through the cross-strait verification mechanism to the Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits or its delegated agency on the mainland. After verification, the local AMR registration file will accept the documents as evidence of shareholder identity and authorization. A Chinese translation prepared by a licensed translation agency must be affixed with the translation agency seal and included in the submission. If the shareholder is an individual, a personal passport and a Taiwanese ID card copy are sufficient; if a legal entity, also provide certified articles of incorporation, a current registration extract and a board resolution authorizing the investment. Allow three working days for Taiwan-side notarization, two working days for cross-strait verification and no less than five working days end-to-end.
required_dossiers: Taiwan shareholder individual passport or Taiwan ID
Power of attorney notarized in Taiwan
Capital contribution declaration executed before a notary
Certified copy of the Taiwan corporate shareholders articles and current registration extract if a corporate investor
Board resolution of the Taiwan investor authorizing the WFOE investment
Chinese translation of all Taiwan notarized documents with translator seal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the verification channel returns an incomplete certification, request a supplementary notarial certificate from the Taiwan notary and re-present it to the Straits Exchange Foundation. If the AMR refuses the authentication package due to translation defects, prepare a corrected Chinese translation and re-certify the same document. If the shareholder authorization lapses, obtain a fresh board resolution and resubmit, preserving the original stamps.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Capital Contribution Account and Wiring of Registered Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank authorized by the State Administration of Foreign Exchange; the bank acts as the capital contribution supervision bank and completes the foreign exchange registration via the SAFE digital registration system when the temporary account is opened.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The future company, represented by its proposed legal representative, opens a temporary capital contribution account in the company name at a bank located where the WFOE will be registered. The bank will request the NAME pre-approval notice, the Articles of Association, the verified Taiwan shareholder documents and the proposed legal representative ID. The bank obtains the foreign exchange registration code from the SAFE system before remittance. The Taiwanese shareholder then wires the agreed registered capital from Taiwan or an overseas account into this temporary account using the instruction letter provided by the bank. All remittances must be lawful and comply with cross-strait banking protocols. After receipt, the bank issues a Paid-In Capital Confirmation and seals a capital verification report for the AMR. Funds remain in the temporary account until the business license is issued, at which time the account is converted into the company basic deposit account and the capital becomes available for lawful operating purposes. If part of the capital is to be contributed in kind, the company must obtain a qualified PRC valuation report, evidence of title transfer, and a notarized appraisal certificate; that process is not required for cash financing in this transaction.
required_dossiers: Name Pre-Approval Notice
Executed Articles of Association
Notarized Taiwan shareholder identity documents
Passport of the proposed legal representative
Application for temporary account opening
SAFE foreign exchange registration code
Bank remittance instruction letter and source-of-funds declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the remitting bank or the receiving bank rejects the wire, obtain the written rejection reason and correct the beneficiary name, account number, SWIFT code or remittance purpose. If the capital supervision bank fails to issue the Paid-In Capital Confirmation within the SLA, ask the bank to escalate internally to its foreign exchange unit or apply to the local SAFE office for an expedited confirmation. If both banks block the remittance, use an alternative SAFE-approved bank and restart the account opening procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Establishment Registration and License Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) enterprise registration hall and the national integrated one-stop online platform.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete establishment application on the AMR integrated platform. Attach the establishment registration application form, the executed Articles of Association, shareholder qualification documents, directors and supervisor appointment letters, legal representative ID, registered address proof, paid-in capital confirmation from the bank and the cross-strait verified Taiwan shareholder documents. The legal representative must sign the application either electronically with a digital certificate or in person before the registration officer. The AMR will review the submitted scope for negative-list compliance and issue the business license with the Unified Social Credit Code. The one-stop platform automatically transfers registration data to the tax bureau, statistics bureau, social insurance authority and customs identification. If the AMR requires further approval from a content or broadcasting department because the business scope is interpreted as more than digital production, the company must first obtain the relevant sector approval. In the ordinary online micro-drama production and distribution model, no industrial permit is required and the establishment license is issued within seven working days after the capital confirmation is filed. A successful filing yields the business license, a stamp for the foreign-invested company, and the company’s enterprise identification number.
required_dossiers: Company establishment registration application form
Articles of Association executed by all shareholders
Notarized and cross-strait verified shareholder documents
Letters appointing the executive director, supervisor, general manager and financial officer
Passports and resident ID copies of all officers
Registered address proof such as lease with landlord property certificate
Paid-In Capital Confirmation from the capital contribution supervision bank
Name Pre-Approval Notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AMR issues a correction notice, respond within the statutory correction period through the portal. If the business license is denied due to the scope wording, amend the scope by removing any broadcasting or news editorial phrase and resubmit. If the denial is based on foreign investment restrictions, request a written explanation and, where appropriate, apply for administrative reconsideration or convert to a joint venture with a PRC licensed partner.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Seals, Basic Bank Account Activation, Tax and Corporate Governance Implementation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau (PSB) seal registration office, the supervisory commercial bank, the local tax bureau, social insurance and housing fund authorities, and the local municipal government service center.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the business license is issued, obtain the company seal engraving authorization from the public security bureau and go to a PSB-licenced engraving shop to produce the company seal, financial seal, legal representative private seal and contract seal. Register each seal with the PSB on the same day or within one working day. Present the business license, seal registration receipts and the board resolution on banking mandates to the capital supervision bank to convert the temporary account into a basic deposit account. The bank will update the signatory matrix and connect the account to the tax bureau for electronic invoice issuance. Complete tax registration, social insurance registration, statistical registration and housing fund registration through the multi-certificate integration portal. Convene the first organizational meeting of the board to ratify these post-license steps, approve a cash-management policy and adopt an internal governance matrix delegating procurement, content licensing and payment approval authority. For the global digital micro-drama distribution app, if a China-hosted website or domain is used, file an ICP registration with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology; this is not an industrial license but an internet presence filing.
required_dossiers: Original business license
PSB seal engraving authorization
Board resolution approving bank mandate and seal custody rules
Corporate seal impression cards
Legal representative and financial officer ID copies
Tax registration questionnaire
Social insurance and housing fund employee information forms
ICP filing information if the streaming app operates a mainland China-facing site
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the PSB delays seal registration, obtain a temporary seal engraving receipt and proceed with bank opening using that receipt. If the bank refuses the account activation because the company seal does not yet appear, provide the PSB seal registration certificate when available. If tax registration is queried due to a missing landlord property certificate, substitute a notarized building ownership certificate or an official real estate inquiry record. Any unresolved administrative suspension may be escalated to the government service center complaints window.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable - the registered activities under ISIC 5911 are the production and global distribution of vertical micro-drama content through a mobile streaming application; there is no physical factory, chemical plant, assembly line, warehouse, inventory storage or hazardous-materials facility. Consequently no municipal industrial licensing board is involved.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable under industrial or physical operating permit rules; the company will hold a standard business license and, if it hosts a China-facing domain, an ICP filing under the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. No manufacturing or warehousing permit applies.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not Applicable - Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China would be the agency only if a physical construction or industrial operation were established; this digital production company creates no construction project and no environmental clearance is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - the project is not a construction project under Article 2 of the Environmental Impact Assessment Law of the People's Republic of China; there is no land disturbance, production process, waste stream or physical installation, and therefore the classification is complete exemption from Full EIA Report and Environmental Registration duties.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable - the project generates no regulated wastewater, no volatile organic compounds, no particulate emissions, no boiler flue gas, and no hazardous waste. If the company later adds an office with significant equipment, it need only comply with municipal solid waste and office wastewater discharge rules generally applicable to commercial offices; any future physical production studio or server warehouse would require a new EIA Screening.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable - because no industrial site, warehouse or chemical process is occupied, no civil defense fire permit, structural load inspection or occupational safety worksite clearance is required. If the company leases an ordinary office, the landlord will provide the building fire inspection certificate, and the company will follow general fire safety and health requirements for office workers, but no civil defense industrial clearance is triggered by the Stage 2 process.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China; electronic filing and registration through the China Electronic Tax Administration (e-Tax) portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Upon incorporation, the local Administration for Market Regulation issues a business license embedding the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which serves as the statutory taxpayer identification number. The Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise must complete tax registration with the competent State Taxation Administration local office within 30 days of license issuance using the e-Tax portal or in-person appointment, submitting the business license, articles of association, legal representative identity document, registered address proof, bank account details, and investor identity/corporate existence documents. The tax authority activates the VAT taxpayer profile (small-scale or general taxpayer) and issues a tax registration record. Foreign non-resident entities without a Chinese establishment may obtain a withholding tax identification number through a local withholding agent via the e-Tax portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None; China applies entity-level taxation based on place of incorporation or place of effective management. No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch entity classification elections are available to a WFOE.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: CNY 5,000,000 aggregate annual taxable turnover for mandatory general VAT taxpayer registration; all newly incorporated entities must register for VAT irrespective of turnover and maintain small-scale taxpayer status until the threshold is exceeded.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The State Taxation Administration mandates digital electronic invoicing through the national fully digitalised electronic invoice system. All VAT invoices must be issued via STA-certified tax control equipment or the e-Tax portal API, cleared in real time into the Golden Tax Project IV database, and carry an anti-fraud digital stamp. Offline manual invoicing and unregistered invoice templates are prohibited.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating for exported services applies where the Chinese WFOE provides qualifying cross-border services, including digital streaming and vertical micro-drama distribution, to non-resident customers, the services are consumed entirely outside China, the export income is received in foreign exchange from abroad, and the transaction is not prohibited by law. The 0% VAT rate is available with refund of attributable input VAT. Physical goods exported across the customs border also qualify for 0% VAT with export rebate under the applicable export VAT refund regime.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: China Customs Export Declaration (Bill of Entry) for physical goods
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill for physical export deliveries
Signed streaming/content licensing agreement with overseas platform or non-resident customer
Foreign exchange inward remittance certificate issued by the Chinese settlement bank
Zero-rated export filing and supporting evidence submitted via the China Electronic Tax Administration (e-Tax) portal
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Failure to substantiate the zero rate with the required documentation within the statutory deadline triggers VAT reassessment at the prevailing standard rate, a late payment surcharge of 0.05% per day on unpaid tax, an administrative penalty ranging from 50% to five times the evaded tax, and retrospective clawback of any VAT refund issued. Fraudulent export VAT claims are prosecuted under the Criminal Law and the Law on the Administration of Tax Collection, carrying penalties up to life imprisonment and asset confiscation in severe cases.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a managed floating exchange rate regime under PBOC and SAFE. Current account transactions, including cross-border licensing fees, online streaming platform revenues and short-drama distribution royalties, are generally eligible for free conversion after factual verification against genuine trade and service background. Capital account operations, including the initial Taiwanese equity injection, remain subject to FDI foreign exchange registration, negative-list compliance and settlement-use restrictions. A Taiwan-invested WFOE may settle its foreign currency capital into RMB only for permitted operating purposes, and cannot use the converted RMB for entrusted loans, securities investment, real estate, or purchases of assets unrelated to the business. Profit repatriation to the Taiwanese shareholder must be supported by audited financial statements, corporate income tax payments, dividend distribution resolutions and a withholding tax certificate, with the surplus currency converted through a domestic licensed bank. There is no free-floating convertibility for pure financial transactions; all settlement practices require an underlying transaction dossier. The real-economy digital content export model of the WFOE, however, benefits from a straightforward current-account adjudication path provided the platform settlement evidences and subscriber dashboards are preserved.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For digital software/audio-visual service exports and overseas streaming receipts, the WFOE must repatriate foreign currency proceeds into China through a domestic designated bank and match the relevant service trade declaration to SAFE's non-trade administration horizon. There is no mandatory forced surrender ratio; conversion to RMB is voluntary, but the bank must maintain the Service Trade Foreign Exchange Declaration filing and the actual contract/invoice reconciliation within the required record retention period. For physical merchandise exports such as DVDs or promotional merchandise, the same repatriation obligation applies and the export receipts must be verified against customs declarations under SAFE's trade monitoring system within the statutory verification period, generally within 180 days unless a longer settlement period is registered under the trade credit framework.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: RMB Basic Settlement Account + Foreign Exchange Capital Settlement Account (FDI)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Basic Operational Current Account + Digital Media Collections Settlement Account
RMB Operating Account + Foreign Currency Current Account (USD/HKD) with Online Trade Settlement
FDI Capital Escrow Account (Upon SAFE Registration) + Payables Clearing Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore fintech EMIs, including Stripe Treasury-like platforms, Wise Business, Revolut Business, and Airwallex, have no legal standing to hold or clear WFOE RMB in mainland China; PBOC/SAFE rules require corporate FX and RMB clearing through licensed banks. Such EMIs cannot issue a mainland bank account number or accept a Taiwan-invested WFOE as an onshore client for treasury clearing. Their only permissible role is ancillary foreign collection support, namely receiving platform payouts from global app stores and then forwarding the net amount via SWIFT into the WFOE's domestic bank; the WFOE remains fully responsible for SAFE service-trade declaration and tax evidence for every inbound transfer.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mainland commercial banks require the WFOE's legal representative as a natural person, together with at least one authorized director or senior manager, to appear physically at the opening branch for face-to-face AML due diligence and signature verification. Remote consular proxy opening is not permitted, although after the initial KYC relationship is established, the bank may accept a certified Power of Attorney for operational account administrators. For the Taiwanese parent's representative, the Taiwanese corporate registry, investor approval and ultimate beneficial owner natural-person identification must be attested by the appointed corporate officer during the in-branch interview; a bank officer will not perform a purely overseas video interview for the WFOE's initial account opening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-Strait ownership chain opacity: beneficial ownership structure with a Taiwanese holding company and natural-person shareholder whose tax residence and domicile must be reconciled with mainland investment approval.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide notarized Taiwan company registration and current directors/shareholders' list, mainland investment license issued by the relevant approval authority, FDI foreign exchange registration certificate from SAFE, audited financial statements of the Taiwanese parent, personal ID/tax ID of each natural-person ultimate beneficial owner, and a written shareholding and control chain map showing the absence of undisclosed nominees or trusts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspect round-tripping or non-commercial use of FDI capital, particularly when the WFOE's initial capital is to be settled into RMB for digital media production and platform operation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the approved business plan and capital budget, target production budget per drama series, third-party production/service contracts with principals, payroll list for actors and crew, signed publishing and distribution agreements with app stores, and a certified forecast of streaming subscriptions demonstrating that capital use falls squarely within the stated ISIC 5911 vertical short-drama business rather than entrusted loans, securities, real estate, or shareholder borrowings.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Revenue anomaly in low-risk digital media: high-volume but fragmented Apple IAP/Google Play/Stripe collections without traceable subscriber identities could be interpreted as pass-through money laundering or unregistered cross-border payment aggregation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver quarterly platform payout reports with app-store statement cycles, subscriber metadata and device country codes, internal accounting ledger mapping each payout batch to distinct drama copyrights, signed licensing contracts for each distribution window, and an external CPA audit of revenue recognition policies under China's accounting standards demonstrating that all collections are genuine consumer streaming receipts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Export/import invoice mismatch under SAFE's trade monitoring system: service trade payments to offshore production agencies or subtitling houses may be challenged as fake purchases or disguised repatriation of profits.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Maintain complete service contracts with overseas vendors, itemized invoices stating service scope, translation/editing/dubbing deliverables and man-hour rates, customs copyright registration where applicable, remittance applications reflecting the true counterparty name and payment purpose code, bank transaction reference numbers, and a notarized confirmation letter from the Taiwanese distribution partner proving the arm's length nature of the arrangement.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The Taiwanese investor must first complete the mainland foreign-invested enterprise approval and SAFE FDI foreign exchange registration, then wire the equity capital from its Taiwan bank account through SWIFT MT103 to the WFOE's domestic designated bank using the purpose of capital injection under FDI registration and the FDI foreign exchange code as filed. Upon receipt, the bank will confirm the remittance against the registered expected capital amount, issue the FDI receipt post-back, and allow the WFOE to convert the foreign exchange into RMB only after the CPA capital verification report and SAFE settlement confirmation are filed. Any inward remittance exceeding the registered capital or without matching FDI registration will be parked in a non-resident temporary account and returned unless the WFOE amends its business license and foreign exchange registration before the bank's verification cutoff.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For overseas streaming distributors and content buyers, the WFOE may use SWIFT MT103 direct transfers for licensing fees, but service trade contracts must be filed in the bank under China's service trade settlement rules. For high-value international co-production or distribution advances, an irrevocable commercial letter of credit can be used with payment terms against presentation of the distribution contract, copyright assignment certificate, final master copy delivery, inspection report and clean signed invoice. Documentary collections may be used for smaller territorial licensing deals, with the commercial invoice, complete-master delivery receipt and downloaded-subscriber report as the accompanying documents. All outbound payments must pass through the domestic clearing bank and cannot be executed by any unlicensed electronic money institution or foreign payment processor without the underlying contract and SAFE declaration.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore CNY/USD deliverable forward contracts with a licensed domestic bank for genuine trade and service payments, supported by contract and invoice evidence.
CNY/HKD or CNY/CNH cross-currency swaps executed for matching the foreign-currency liability of licensed distribution payments, with maturity and notional aligned to the underlying cash flow.
FX swap transactions between spot and forward exchange rates confined to short-term liquidity conversion for working capital rounding.

Offshore CNH non-deliverable forwards may be considered only through the Taiwan or Hong Kong parent treasury entity for its own custodian risk, not by the mainland WFOE, because mainland banks cannot provide NDF products without the required actual-needs hedge exemption.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No sector-specific holiday for vertical micro-drama streamers. Principal effective reliefs: (1) Small-and-Low-Profit Enterprise (SLPE) regime: taxable income not exceeding CNY 3 million, employees not exceeding 300 and total assets not exceeding CNY 50 million qualifies for the reduced rate of 20% with taxable income reduced to 25%, producing a 5% effective rate; (2) R&D super-deduction at 100% of qualifying platform/app development expenditure; (3) no preferential rate for ordinary foreign investment in digital content; (4) Western-region and Free-Trade-Zone incentives available only if the WFOE is sited in designated zones and meets the encouraged-industry catalogue, which short-drama production does not ordinarily satisfy.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: PRC Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return (Form A, 2017 revision), comprising Form A000000 Basic Information Sheet, Form A100000 Main Return, and supporting schedules A105000-A107050; filed through the National Unified Electronic Tax Bureau portal (e-Tax) which integrates the annual settlement (annual filing and reconciliation) module.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 5 months after the fiscal year-end, i.e. 31 May for a 31 December year-end; quarterly prepayments are credited against the annual assessed liability in the same filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, unified social credit code, industry classification, accounting standard, fiscal-year dates, SLPE eligibility indicators, tax incentive flags, and related-party disclosure flags.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose the Taiwan corporate shareholder legal name, registry jurisdiction, shareholding percentage and related-party codes; mark all cross-border transactions involving micro-drama IP licensing, content production services and treasury arrangements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form A100000 - Main Return, Line 1 (Operating Revenue)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross subscription and advertising revenue from the short-drama streaming app, net of VAT, after Apple IAP, Google Play Billing and Stripe commissions, recognized under PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All China-source streaming revenue collected through app stores is reportable in the WFOE as the beneficial operator; no pass-through treatment is allowed to the Taiwan parent or a Taiwan consolidated treasury center.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form A100000 - Main Return, Line 2 (Operating Cost)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Content production cost, third-party talent and crew fees, amortization of capitalized short-drama IP production costs, and amortization of exclusive drama copyrights and sub-licenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: IP amortization must correspond to an arm's-length license-in cost from the Taiwan licensor; the WFOE must maintain comparable license benchmarking and exploitation documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form A100000 - Main Return, Lines 3-6 (Taxes and Surcharges; Selling, Administrative and Financial Expenses)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Inclusion of VAT city maintenance and education surcharges, advertising and promotion expenditure, general management overheads, cross-border platform commission fees and related-party interest expense.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany service fees from the Taiwan head office are non-deductible without contemporaneous evidence of actual services and benefit; related-party interest is capped by the 2:1 debt-equity thin-capitalization rule and must bear arm's-length rates.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form A100000 - Main Return, Lines 13-19 (Total Profit, Adjustments and Taxable Income)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting total profit before tax, adjusted under Schedule A105000 for entertainment expense (60% floor and 5 per mille of revenue ceiling), advertising expense (15% of revenue ceiling), non-deductible related-party fees, sponsorship disallowances and the 5-year carryforward loss offset.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Taiwan-source operating losses of the parent cannot offset PRC taxable income of the WFOE; deductions for intra-group royalties require beneficial-owner and economic-substance proof.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form A100000 - Main Return, Lines 20-26 (Tax at 25%, Credits and Net Assessable)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Headline tax computed at 25% on Line 19; reduction taken for SLPE favorable rate and 100% R&D super-deduction; foreign tax credit is not available on Taiwan parent-level taxes because the WFOE is a PRC domestic entity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders are not subject to PRC CIT at the entity level; the return is filed on a stand-alone PRC entity basis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form A100000 - Main Return, Lines 27-28 (Prepayments and Balance Due)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly prepayments already paid are credited; the balance of annual CIT is payable with the filing, and the release of the e-tax control number confirms discharge for dividend remittance approval.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Remittances to the Taiwan shareholder require the annual CIT clearance receipt; the dividend WHT is computed and paid separately on Form F of the Non-Resident Tax Withholding Return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Annual Related-Party Transaction Reporting Forms (Form G100000 Schedules G102000-G107000)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Mandatory disclosure of cross-border related-party balances and transactions, including IP royalties, content production service fees, short-term loans and financial transactions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report every transaction with the Taiwan shareholder and its affiliates regardless of whether the Local File threshold is met; aggregate transactional information must reconcile with bank and App Store settlement records.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual filing: administrative penalty of up to RMB 10,000 (generally RMB 2,000 first instance) under Article 62 of the Tax Collection Administration Law; late payment: daily surcharge of 0.05% on the unpaid tax under Article 32; persistent delinquency triggers 'abnormal taxpayer' status, invoice quota restrictions, exit-exam denial and mandatory tax inspection.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: PRC Enterprise Income Tax Quarterly Prepayment Return (Form A, 2021 revision) filed through the National Unified Electronic Tax Bureau portal; election allowed to prepay by instalment based on actual cumulative profit or on the prior-year basis.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 15 days after the end of each quarter; Q1 due 15 April, Q2 due 15 July, Q3 due 15 October and Q4 due 15 January of the following year; the Q4 prepayment is typically merged with the annual settlement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 1-3 (Cumulative Revenue, Operating Cost and Cumulative Profit)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cumulative book revenue, cost and total profit for the current year, prepared on a year-to-date basis consistent with interim PRC GAAP financial statements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The prepayment is prepared solely for the WFOE; no consolidation with the Taiwan parent is permitted, and App Store settlement reports must support the cumulative revenue figure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cumulative actual profit after temporary disallowances; taxable income is computed by the simplified method with no carryforward loss offset unless the enterprise has elected the actual-profit method with prior approval.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Marketing and entertainment expense ceilings apply only in the annual reconciliation; if the enterprise knowingly under-pre-pays on a recurring basis, the deficiency will attract late-payment surcharge at annual settlement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable at 25% (or SLPE effective rate) on cumulative taxable profit less cumulative prepayments for prior quarters of the same year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No foreign tax credit or treaty relief is recognized in the prepayment; these are annual-return adjustments only.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late quarterly prepayment: daily 0.05% surcharge on the under-prepaid amount; administrative penalty up to RMB 10,000; repeated default triggers automatic public credit-rating downgrade and enhanced bank foreign-exchange review for dividend remittances.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% (withholding at source by the WFOE as payer on dividends distributed to the Taiwan corporate shareholder; the 10% rate is the PRC statutory dividend WHT on non-resident enterprises)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Cross-Strait Tax Agreement (2010 Agreement on Avoidance of Double Taxation and Prevention of Tax Evasion with Taiwan, implemented domestically) limits dividend WHT to 5% where the Taiwan beneficial owner directly holds at least 25% of the WFOE capital, and to 10% otherwise. Protocol: (1) the Taiwan shareholder must obtain a Taiwan Tax Resident Certificate (NTIA residence certificate); (2) before or at the time of payment, submit the Non-Resident Tax Treaty Treatment Report Form under SAT Announcement 2015 No. 60, together with a beneficial-owner declaration evidencing substance under the six factors of SAT Announcement 2018 No. 9 (actual management, employees, assets, function and risk, bank account and business activities); (3) the WFOE withholds at 5% only after the tax authority accepts the filing; if the TRC or substance documentation is incomplete, the statutory 10% must be withheld and a refund claim may be filed within 3 years; (4) competent-authority assistance is available through the cross-strait mutual agreement procedure.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 10% on royalties and 10% on interest paid to a non-resident. Treaty rate under the Cross-Strait Tax Agreement: 7.5% on royalties for the license of film/drama IP, copyrights and know-how, and 7.5% on interest paid to Taiwan banks or enterprises. Treaty benefits require the same TRC and beneficial-owner documentation; royalty deductions in the WFOE are also subject to the related-party documentation rules and economic-substance review.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Master File: required when aggregate related-party transactions in the prior fiscal year equal or exceed CNY 1 billion. Local File: required when annual related-party transactions reach: (a) tangible asset transfers of CNY 100 million or more; (b) intangible property transfers of CNY 100 million or more; (c) financial asset transactions of CNY 100 million or more; (d) other related-party transactions of CNY 40 million or more. For the micro-drama WFOE, the relevant threshold is most likely 'other related-party transactions' (royalties, content services, platform fees) of CNY 40 million; below the threshold, contemporaneous documentation should still be prepared on a risk-based request under SAT Announcement 2016 No. 42.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: PRC law does not apply the UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations code, but applies an equivalent substance-over-form doctrine: (1) the Beneficial Owner six-factor test of SAT Announcement 2018 No. 9 requires the WFOE to have actual personnel, premises, decision-making authority, risk-bearing and operational substance; (2) the General Anti-Avoidance Rule under Article 47 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law and Article 120 of the Tax Collection Administration Law allows recharacterization of shell structures; (3) the Cross-Strait Tax Agreement is implemented by domestic legislation and is not a covered-tax-agreement under China's BEPS MLI, so PRC anti-abuse rules apply strictly; a Taiwan-owned WFOE that books app-store revenue in China but makes all decisions in Taipei is vulnerable to denial of DTA rates and deemed-dividend recharacterization.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion - Suppression of OTT/Streaming Revenue and False Invoicing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Understating Apple IAP and Google Play Billing gross receipts in VAT and CIT filings; diverting micro-drama subscription revenue to personal Alipay/WeChat Pay collection codes; procuring fictitious VAT invoices for actor and crew costs; falsifying App Store Connect settlement reports.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recovery of underpaid tax plus 0.05% daily late-payment surcharge; administrative penalty of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax under Article 63 of the Tax Collection Administration Law; criminal tax evasion under Article 201 of the Criminal Law with fines of 1-5 times the evaded amount and imprisonment of up to 7 years where the evaded amount exceeds RMB 100,000 and constitutes more than 30% of the tax due; revocation of VAT invoice issuance rights and business license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil under Article 20 of the PRC Company Law; directors and the Taiwan-nominated legal representative jointly and severally liable for civil restitution; travel bans under the exit-exam procedure; personal disqualification from new company registration and imprisonment as joint offenders where fraudulent conduct is proven.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Abuse and Special Tax Adjustment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying non-arm's-length royalties and intra-group production or network fees to the Taiwan parent so that the WFOE books continuous losses while the Taiwan group captures 100% of the micro-drama profit; absence of benchmarking, absence of contemporaneous TP documentation, and royalty rates exceeding arm's-length comparables.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Special Tax Adjustment under SAT Announcement 2017 No. 6: upward income adjustment, retroactive reassessment for up to 10 years, interest at the benchmark lending rate plus 5 percentage points from the due date of the underpaid tax, and where false related-party reporting is established, a penalty of up to 50% of the underpaid tax; burden of proof shifts to the taxpayer where documentation is withheld.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and financial officers who execute the intercompany agreements are subject to secondary adjustment collection; exit-exam denial and travel bans; civil joint liability for amounts assessed where the board authorized the artificial pricing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Dividend WHT Evasion through Constructive Distribution and Unreported Shareholder Loans
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accumulating profits in the WFOE while paying no dividends, yet advancing interest-free or below-market loans to the Taiwan parent or its affiliates; carrying a growing current-account receivable in excess of accumulated profits; failing to withhold 10% (or 5% treaty rate) on the economic distribution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterization of the unpaid receivable/loan balance as a deemed dividend under GAAR and the beneficial-owner doctrine; WHT assessment at 10% (or 5% if treaty substance is proven) on the deemed amount plus 0.05% daily surcharge; administrative penalty up to 50% of the un-withheld tax; Article 47 EIT Law recharacterization and potential criminal sanction if foreign-exchange evasion is also established.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil restitution by directors who authorized the cash-flow arrangement; SAFE foreign-exchange violation fines and individual travel restrictions; criminal liability for concealing foreign-exchange receipts under the Regulations on Foreign Exchange Administration where cross-border fund flows were disguised.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML, Shell Company and Economic Substance Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the WFOE as a nominal shell with no physical office, fewer than 3 employees and bank accounts controlled exclusively by Taiwan nominees; rapid round-tripping of IAP and Stripe proceeds to the Taiwan parent within 24-48 hours; misrepresenting beneficial ownership to banks and the SAT; failing the six-factor substance test on a dividend treaty claim.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of the 5%/7.5% cross-strait treaty rates with WHT re-assessed at the full 10% statutory rate; AML institutional fines of up to RMB 2 million plus individual fines under the PRC Anti-Money Laundering Law; freezing orders on WFOE bank accounts; Criminal Law Article 191 money-laundering offense with fines and imprisonment of up to 10 years where collected funds are derived from fraudulent subscription schemes; delisting from e-tax normal-taxpayer status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors face personal asset forfeiture, travel bans, prohibition from acting as directors of any PRC entity, personal liability for the unpaid WHT and AML fines, and criminal prosecution for participation in a money-laundering or tax-evasion conspiracy.
